filament_settings_id: zz Generic PLA Fast @BBL X2D 0.6 nozzle
name: zz Generic PLA Fast @BBL X2D 0.6 nozzle
description: Personal preset - the 'zz' prefix sorts it last in the preset lists. Generic PLA with flow pushed for a 0.6 mm hotend: volumetric speed 30 on every variant (Bambu ships 12 for Generic PLA) and 230 C for the flow headroom that needs. Layer cooling cut to 4 s / 40 mm/s. First test print for the 0.6 hotend - lower the volumetric speed toward 24 if walls come out thin or gaps appear between infill lines.
